text: The far sentry can see the near one, given the right two walls. After that, look for a panel you could not see before. The door wants one of them on the scale. It does not mind which.

The spark comes out above my door and hits the wall behind you. Each mark faces something that would very much like a spark. The shutters are another matter. One answers to a switch. The other answers to a spark of its own.
That was not an interlock. That was the latch on my last shutter, and you have opened it with one of my own sparks. I would like it noted that I find that rude.

The field takes your portals if you walk through it. Light is not the only thing that can go in at the pillar and come out at the panel. Whatever goes in comes out wherever the panel happens to be at the time.
